sources.snippet: The Llama 3.1 405B model is the flagship of the Llama 3.1 series, standing out as the largest and most powerful variant in Meta's collection of AI models. Built on a dense transformer architecture, this model leverages a vast 128K context window, allowing it to handle large volumes of data and maintain contextual awareness over extended inputs.
